in_marathi.name: Gatiksha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the Goals or Steps
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gatiksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gati means 'goals' or 'steps'. Ksha means 'field' or 'space'. Thus, Gatiksha means 'Goddess of the Goals' or 'Goddess of the Steps'. She is believed to guide and protect those who seek to achieve their goals in life.

in_bengali.name: Gatiksha

Thus, Gatiksha means 'Goddess of the Goals' or 'Goddess of the Steps'. She is believed to guide and protect those who seek to achieve their goals in life.
